Enrollment

Submitting an inquiry does not guarantee enrollment. Enrollment depends on availability, age-group capacity, licensing requirements, completed documentation, and acceptance of daycare policies.

Enrollment Process

  1. Submit an inquiry.
  2. Speak with the caregiver.
  3. Schedule a daycare tour.
  4. Discuss the child’s needs and availability.
  5. Review required enrollment documents.
  6. Complete registration forms.
  7. Confirm a start date.

Current Availability

Infants: Available by inquiry only, based on licensing capacity and current enrollment.

Toddlers: Please contact us for current openings.

Preschool: Please contact us for current openings.

Inquiry Information to Prepare

  • Age of child
  • Preferred start date
  • Desired schedule
  • Full-time or part-time care
  • Allergies or special considerations
  • Tour request
